ticket.subject: Contacts export incomplete
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Writing on behalf of Brambleway Studio. When I export the Contacts list to CSV, the file stops at exactly 1,000 rows, although we have about 4,800 contacts.

This started after last week's release; it worked before. We can work around it by exporting in smaller filtered batches, but it takes a long time. Here is a screen recording of the problem: https://drive.example.org/view?id=5521&key=Zp4Lk8 Our office egress IP is 203.0.113.7, in case that helps with the logs.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Could you look into it?

Thanks,
Mei Kowalczyk
